scope: Adaptive architecture development on the same 4977 Okutama centers; not external confirmation
equation: softmax(log(p_M4 + epsilon) + g * (log(p_A3 + epsilon) - log(p_M4 + epsilon)))

r1_fixed_10pct_a3.purpose: predeclared calibration sentinel motivated by the completed post-hoc diagnostic

r2_uncertainty_risk_gate.purpose: test whether output uncertainty and disagreement alone route A3 safely
r2_uncertainty_risk_gate.gate: risk-weighted logistic correction utility; smooth activation from 0.50 to 0.70

r3_boundary_risk_gate.gate: R2 plus M4-predicted boundary, attention, survival and compact temporal-change evidence; smooth activation from 0.50 to 0.70; suppress predicted standing-to-sitting switches

r4_direct_boundary_switch.purpose: mechanism control for learned correction utility
r4_direct_boundary_switch.gate: hard A3 switch when M4 predicted-boundary score exceeds the outer-training threshold maximizing boundary F1; suppress predicted standing-to-sitting switches

r5_unrestricted_gate.purpose: failure control without risk weighting, activation floor or standing-to-sitting protection

inputs.anchor: new-source M4 selected inner OOF predictions and three outer refit seeds
inputs.residual_expert: A3 unrestricted-template selected inner OOF predictions and three outer refit seeds
gate_features: M4 and A3 probabilities, entropy, margin, confidence advantage and disagreement
M4 learned memory gate, attention, survival and boundary probabilities
A3 slot-mass entropy, maximum share, effective-slot count and active-slot count
short/long V-JEPA and DINO norm, cosine and relative-change summaries
forbidden_inference_features: true boundary, purity or interval stratum

splitting.router_training_inputs: selected inner OOF M4 and A3 predictions covering only the outer-training scenarios
splitting.router_evaluation_inputs: three selected outer-refit seeds for M4 and A3 on the untouched outer-held scenarios
splitting.outer_metric_embargo: no held labels are scored or logged until all five fold artifacts validate

router.training_population: rows where M4 and A3 predicted classes disagree
router.negative_target: all other disagreements, including M4 corrections and neither-model-correct rows
router.direct_boundary_selection: outer-training node-support-boundary F1 descending, threshold descending on ties

statistics.multiplicity: none; one primary contrast; other arms are mechanism and failure controls

interpretation.development_status: All results are repeated-development evidence because M4, A3 and the boundary hypothesis were discovered on these same rows
interpretation.stage_1: This cached screen tests whether complementarity is routable before any expensive transported-part implementation
interpretation.stage_2: Only a gate that improves the anchor with positive net corrections justifies actor-relative temporal part transport
interpretation.post_hoc_warning: No arm may be renamed primary or selected after outer metrics are released
